options.name: auth_ind
options.description: Defines an allow list for Authentication Indicators. Use 'otp' to allow OTP-based 2FA authentications. Use 'radius' to allow RADIUS-based 2FA authentications. Other values may be used for custom configurations. Use empty string to reset auth_ind to the initial value.

options.name: certificate
options.description: List of base-64 encoded host certificates

options.name: description
options.description: The host description

options.name: force
options.description: Force host name even if not in DNS

options.name: hosts
options.description: The list of host dicts

options.name: ip_address
options.description: The host IP address list (IPv4 and IPv6). No IP address conflict check will be done.

options.name: ipaadmin_password
options.description: The admin password.

options.name: ipaadmin_principal
options.description: The admin principal.

options.name: ipaapi_context
options.description:
The context in which the module will execute. Executing in a
server context is preferred. If not provided context will be
determined by the execution environment.

options.name: ipaapi_ldap_cache
options.description: Use LDAP cache for IPA connection.

options.name: locality
options.description: Host locality (e.g. "Baltimore, MD")

options.name: location
options.description: Host location (e.g. "Lab 2")

options.name: mac_address
options.description: List of hardware MAC addresses.

options.name: managedby_host
options.description: List of hosts that can manage this host

options.name: name
options.description: The full qualified domain name.

options.name: ok_as_delegate
options.description: Client credentials may be delegated to the service

options.name: ok_to_auth_as_delegate
options.description: The service is allowed to authenticate on behalf of a client

options.name: os
options.description: Host operating system and version (e.g. "Fedora 9")

options.name: password
options.description: Password used in bulk enrollment

options.name: platform
options.description: Host hardware platform (e.g. "Lenovo T61")

options.name: principal
options.description: List of principal aliases for this host

options.name: random
options.description: Initiate the generation of a random password to be used in bulk enrollment

options.name: requires_pre_auth
options.description: Pre-authentication is required for the service

options.name: reverse
options.description: Reverse DNS detection

options.name: sshpubkey
options.description: List of SSH public keys

options.name: state
options.description: State to ensure

options.name: update_dns
options.description: Controls the update of the DNS SSHFP records for existing hosts and the removal of all DNS entries if a host gets removed with state absent.

options.name: update_password
options.description: Set password for a host in present state only on creation or always

options.name: userclass
options.description: Host category (semantics placed on this attribute are for local interpretation)
